test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The story did not __go by__ well enough.
solution: The correct answer is **Go down.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is Go down. • ''Go Down' means to be remembered or recorded in a particular place or way. (किसी विशेष स्थान या तरीके से याद किया जाना या दर्ज किया जाना) • For example - The efforts they made** will go down** in history. • **Go by** is a idiom, used for To physically pass by someone or something. • Thus the correct answer is Go down.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Go through** means **to be approved or accepted. (**स्वीकृत या स्वीकार किया जाना**)** • **Go down** means **to move down to a lower level or place. (**किसी निचले स्तर या स्थान पर चले जाना**)** • **Go off** means **stop running, functioning, or operating. (**दौड़ना, कार्य करना या संचालन करना बंद करें**)** • **Go into **means** to penetrate something. (**किसी चीज़ में घुसना**)** 46:Tee2, The correct answer is- **"Bird's eye view"**.
